description: This file declares the class ProtobufIRDiffDumper, which is a specialized implementation of IRDiffDumper for handling Protocol Buffer based IR differences. It includes methods for adding various types of IR differences and outputs for protobuf-based IR representations in the context of a header checker tool.

classes.name: ProtobufIRDiffDumper
classes.description: A class for dumping IR differences specifically using protobuf representations, extending IRDiffDumper with protobuf-specific methods and data members.

methods.name: ProtobufIRDiffDumper(const std::string & dump_path)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dumper with a dump path and sets up a new TranslationUnitDiff for protobuf IR differences.

methods.name: ~ProtobufIRDiffDumper()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: AddDiffMessageIR
methods.description: Adds a message IR diff to the dump, associated with a specific type stack and diff kind.

methods.name: AddLinkableMessageIR
methods.description: Adds a linkable message IR diff to the dump.

methods.name: AddElfSymbolMessageIR
methods.description: Adds an ELF symbol message IR diff.

methods.name: AddLibNameIR
methods.description: Adds a library name IR.

methods.name: AddArchIR
methods.description: Adds architecture info IR.

methods.name: AddCompatibilityStatusIR
methods.description: Adds the compatibility status IR.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Performs the dump operation, likely serializing stored differences.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStatusIR
methods.description: Returns the overall compatibility status IR.

methods.name: AddRecordTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a record type diff IR, associated with a type stack and diff kind.

methods.name: AddEnumTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds an enum type diff IR.

methods.name: AddFunctionDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a function diff IR.

methods.name: AddGlobalVarDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a global variable diff IR.

methods.name: AddLoneRecordTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a lone record type diff IR.

methods.name: AddLoneEnumTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a lone enum type diff IR.

methods.name: AddLoneFunctionDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a lone function diff IR.

methods.name: AddLoneGlobalVarDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a lone global variable diff IR.

methods.name: AddElfObjectIR
methods.description: Adds an ELF object IR representation.

methods.name: AddElfFunctionIR
methods.description: Adds an ELF function IR.
